summary:
## Verdict

Broken contributor pointer in `README.md`; the accompanying lockfile change looks unrelated and should be confirmed intentional.

## Notes

`README.md` now says "See CONTRIBUTING." but this repository has no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or other contributor guide at the root (or under the shallow tree). Readers following that sentence hit a dead end.

`poetry.lock` is also modified on this docs-titled PR (omitted from inline review as a lockfile). Its presence next to a one-line README touch-up is worth a maintainer glance so an accidental re-resolve does not land with the docs fix.

No repository instruction files (`AGENTS.md` / review extensions) were present to apply extra conventions.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
